tool_args.rationale: The base-field, sink-gradient, and coupled-lag signatures favor the archived five-parameter siphon-memory ODE. The pilot already brackets the target horizon of 0.46; the missing information is how the transient evolves within that window. Acquire the trajectory batch before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoint measurements at similar horizons do not reliably separate the memory relaxation time and coupling from the sink-modulated forcing.
It captures sink inhibition but omits the observed coupled transient lag.
It does not resolve the ambiguity between transient memory and sink-modulated forcing.
